fields.flowNotes:
Six screens on rough sheets. Checkpoint 1 job: four flatmates splitting rent, electricity and the maid, where one pays everything then chases the rest.

Set up the flat comes first: the payer types the flat name, adds three flatmates by number, and enters the three fixed amounts. Done takes him to the month view.

The month view is where he lands every time after that, and it carries the product. This month's total at the top, one row per flatmate with what they owe and a green tick if they paid, and 'Ask everyone' at the bottom.

'Ask everyone' opens a confirm screen showing the exact UPI request going to each person with the amount. Send fires them and returns to the month view with 'Requested today' under each name.

Adding a one-off bill is its own screen, from the + on the month view: what it was, how much, who it splits between, equally or not. Saving recalculates the month view.

There is a first-run empty state, 'No bills yet this month', with one button to the add-a-bill screen.

And a failure screen, because UPI requests expire: 'This request expired on the 12th' against that flatmate's row with 'Send it again', going back to the confirm screen.

Sorry about the photos. I drew them over three nights, the tube light in my PG is behind me so everything came out dark, and I did not number the sheets, so the photo order is not the order above.
